policy.controls: Build uses WASD planar movement, PageUp/PageDown altitude, Home/End yaw; mouse stays native builder cursor. Release holds level position. Separate0..60m/s precision speed is real-time and independent of simulation percentage.
policy.collision: Generated terrain, structures and unit bodies remain obstacles. Precision navigation clamps movement without crash trauma or impulses. Normal running movement commits through UnitMotionBridge; at Build0 only the controlled unit moves through native Unit.move, without Unit.update or any simulation tick.
policy.camera: FPV POV angle0..180:0 down,90 forward,180 up. Migrate original signed fpv-tilt once by adding90. Existing independent downward Build tilt is preserved. FOV slider0..180 projects at1..179 to keep perspective matrices finite.
policy.ui: Build panel labels precision Build speed separately from flight speed. Collapsible flight/camera settings expose mode, view and flight speed; focused text/dialogs suspend inputs. HUD shows mode/view/speed multiplier.
policy.compatibility: Native map/economy/build queues preserved; physical combat and multiplayer authority deliberately replaced by spatial modules. Build pause is local single-player only; multiplayer uses live shared simulation.
policy.flightSpeed: Separate25..300% flight speed applies to every performance preset by recalibrating drag equilibrium, preserving mass/thrust/inertia/pose and practical400m/s safety bound. Build precision speed remains separate.
policy.stabilized: F9 Acro/Stabilized. Stabilized WASD uses pilot horizontal heading: W forward, D strafe right; E/Q or PgUp/PgDn altitude. Camera pitch never supplies vertical movement. Level body faces pilot heading even while stopped/strafe/reverse, keeping fixed native weapon cones aligned. Bounded acceleration/braking and per-substep contacts remain.
policy.view: F7 cycles first/chase/rear. Rear puts camera ahead of aircraft looking backwards, observation only: weapon direction remains pilot forward. One-time migration of fpv-third-person boolean to fpv-camera-view integer. Build keeps first-person builder and restores flight view.
policy.firing: Flight trigger applied after native builder input; held LMB is not blocked by retained build selection, configurable tiles beneath craft, stale building flag, or hidden pointer hover. Modal/text/focus, Build Mode, death and native unit status/reload/ammo remain enforced. Native XY weapon aim follows the same physical ray as XYZ projectile aim.

tests: Pure diagonal/heading/hold/speed and camera boundary checks
Native paused movement without tick, wave or grid changes; nonzero scaled motion bridge
Native camera endpoints finite, original construction/time presets and saves still work
Actual resolved speed changes in every preset and sustained integration
Heading-relative stabilized basis at cardinal and arbitrary headings, camera pitch independence, brake/diagonal limits, per-substep collision
Chase camera/own-unit rendering and720tile altitude with finite frustum and map picking
First/chase/rear camera cycle, rear does not reverse guns, live native fixed mounts can fire while moving sideways/backward and over configurable tiles
